notes: The bucket starts full (capacity tokens) and refills continuously, capped at capacity, so fractional tokens carry over; allow(t) is True and spends one token when at least 1 token is available, and a rejected request spends nothing. t is non-decreasing (repeats allowed) and refill_per_sec may be 0. Test times and rates are exact binary fractions (like 0.25 or 1.5), so compare tokens >= 1 directly; no epsilon is needed.
